info.name: Email Delivery ${email Ippool Tag} ${email Ippool Tag} API
Gets a list of all EmailIpPools in the specified compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID for the compartment.

params.name: id
params.description: A filter to only return resources that match the given id exactly.

params.name: name
params.description: A filter to only return resources that match the given name exactly.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: Filter returned list by specified lifecycle state. This parameter is case-insensitive.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. `1` is the minimum, `1000` is the maximum. For important details about
how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works,
see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending or descending order.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
Specifies the attribute with which to sort the Email IpPools.

Default: `TIMECREATED`

* **TIMECREATED:** Sorts by timeCreated.

params.name: emailIpPoolId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the IpPool.

info.name: Gets a list of all Outbound Public IPs assigned for the given tenant.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID for the compartment.

params.name: outboundIp
params.description: The outbound IP address assigned to the tenancy.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. `1` is the minimum, `1000` is the maximum. For important details about
how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works,
see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending or descending order.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: Filter returned list by specified lifecycle state. This parameter is case-insensitive.

params.name: assignmentState
params.description: Filter returned list by specified assignment state.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. The `OUTBOUNDIP` value returns the list in
ascending order or Outbound Ip address by default. Use the `SortOrderQueryParam` to change the
direction of the returned list of items.

items.docs: Returns a list of all Outbound Public IPs assigned for a given tenant.
